ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity black pixel field with localized high-intensity white pixel disruptions; white-to-black pixel ratio estimated at approximately 0.05:1.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogenous black base pigmentation across visible surface; distinct high-contrast white linear streaks located in the lower-mid region of the left lobe and lower-central region of the right lobe; sparse white circular pixel clusters (stippling) distributed across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal vertex angle of approximately 55 degrees; depth is significant relative to total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge; high-frequency, low-amplitude pixel variations on the left lobe; extreme high-amplitude, high-frequency irregular topography at the distal tip of the right lobe due to textured protrusions.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature fitted to the trailing edges of both the left and right lobes extending from the median notch vertex to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated cluster of high-contrast, textured circular pixel groupings on the outer margin and tip of the right lobe, consistent with biological encrustation.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct white linear pixel disruptions; prominent vertical/diagonal rake marks visible on the mid-left lobe and several smaller horizontal linear marks on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable protrusion and textured mass at the distal tip of the right lobe, altering the expected smooth geometric contour of the edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Scattered high-intensity white circular points (stipple marks) distributed non-uniformly across the ventral surface, most prominent near the fluke's central axis.
